verdict.rationale: Supabase officially documents and ships an MCP server enabling AI agents to connect and query Supabase projects, matching the story directly. However, a concrete, documented hands-on exploit (HN write-up) showed the official MCP integration could be tricked via prompt injection into leaking sensitive data by bypassing RLS through the service_role key, and Supabase's own engineer confirmed the issue and added partial mitigations while acknowledging prompt injection remains unsolved — a real-world contradiction of trouble-free 'connect an agent' operation. missing for 10: independent confirmation the vulnerability is now fully resolved, and clearer first-party guidance restricting production use as called out by community members.
